verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page states the desktop is available in many languages thanks to a global community of translators, which covers the core of this story. The evidence is a single marketing line, and no community reports address localization. Missing for 10: list of supported languages or translation completeness, documentation on switching or installing language packs, independent or hands-on corroboration of localized use.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use the desktop in my own language thanks to community or official translations

citations.quote: Thanks to a global community of translators, Workstation is available in many languages.
